This service involves Everstake setting up, running, securing, and maintaining blockchain validators, offering fully managed operations, native slashing protections, and monitoring dashboards [9, 10]. The VaaS infrastructure is enterprise-grade, SOC 2 compliant, and can be deployed in approximately 72 hours [2, 4, 7]. It is suitable for treasuries, funds, corporate holdings, ETF issuers, custodians, asset managers, exchanges, wallets, banks, lenders, and fintech applications [1, 3, 4, 9]. Specific use cases include generating treasury yield without DevOps, providing custodian client offerings across Proof-of-Stake networks, facilitating PoS governance participation, and supporting validator migration [1]. Notable clients utilizing Everstake's services include Crypto.com, Exodus, Trezor, and Paribu Custody [1].
